cases.commit: feat(web): hosts directory with a name search
cases.why: The controlled SearchInput value reaches HostRows on every keystroke; the kit's useSearchDraft exists for this. The compiler cannot help: the prop really changes.

cases.commit: feat(web): hosts screen lists each host's sessions
cases.why: The screen subscribes to useSessions only to hand it to one section. `sessions ?? []` gets past check:structure's regex, so only judgment catches it.

cases.commit: feat(web): host board highlights the hovered card
cases.why: The context value carries the hover id beside the density, so every pointer move re-renders every card.

cases.commit: feat(web): rename host form with name suggestions
cases.why: watch('name') at the top of the form re-renders the field, the counter, every suggestion and the submit button on each keystroke; the counter and the button should read it through useWatch in leaves. The compiler also skips the form: it lists react-hook-form's watch() as an incompatible library.

cases.commit: feat(web): host tabs keep a host lit after a heartbeat blip
cases.why: Writing ref.current during render makes the compiler skip the strip, which the terminal pane re-renders on every status change.
An effect that resets state on a prop change, inside hooks/ where Biome allows effects. It renders the stale draft once, then again.

cases.commit: feat(web): notice when a session's host goes offline
cases.why: A hand-built callout where Alert exists, and two English sentences outside t(). Every class is a token, so lint:design is silent.

cases.commit: feat(web): fleet view labels each session with its host
cases.why: A Map rebuilt from the host list goes to every row, so any settle of the host query re-renders every session row, even those whose host did not change.

cases.commit: feat(web): hosts sidebar shows the active filter
cases.why: Imports another feature's component. pnpm arch fails; the audit has to run it and report it, not re-derive it.

cases.commit: feat(web): host list shows when each host last answered
cases.why: Decoy for R4/R6: the one-second tick lives in the leaf that shows it, and the effect names its system.

cases.commit: feat(web): hosts directory with a name search
cases.why: Decoy for R3: the same feature as live-search-to-list, done the way the rules ask.

cases.commit: feat(web): track whether the hosts tab is visible
cases.why: Decoy for R9: an effect in hooks/ that subscribes to a DOM event and says so.
